tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards. Mobile screens sit directly on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, sheets, the sidebar and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: stepper track, segmented controls, table header row.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for rows and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and card borders. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons (3:1 against surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, placeholders, units. 4.5:1+ on bg, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: The brand blue. Primary buttons, the voice button, links, selected tab, focus ring. Text in frost passes 4.5:1 on surface and frost-soft.

tokens.name: frost-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed for frost fills; frost text on frost-soft when extra weight is needed.

tokens.name: on-frost
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a frost or frost-strong fill. Never hard-code white.

tokens.name: frost-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chips, category tiles, the 'add' rows in a voice review, info callouts.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Illustrative fill only: listening rings, empty-state art, chart bars, the cover. Never behind body text.

tokens.name: fresh
tokens.usage: Freshness: well within its freezer life. Text/icon on surface and fresh-soft.

tokens.name: fresh-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Fresh badge.

tokens.name: soon
tokens.usage: Freshness: approaching its best-by window — eat this next. Text/icon on surface and soon-soft.

tokens.name: soon-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Use soon badge and the 'Eat next' callout.

tokens.name: expired
tokens.usage: Freshness: past its best-by date; also destructive actions (Remove all, Delete freezer). Text/icon on surface and expired-soft.

tokens.name: expired-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Past best badge and destructive confirmations.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed layer behind the voice sheet and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ring offset 2px from the control, in frost.

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Desktop page titles and the one big number on a stat card.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Mobile screen titles; the voice transcript.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings, sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two pounds of ground beef, added Sep 12.
styles.usage: Default text. 15px keeps lists dense on phones while staying readable.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chips, table headers, badges.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under an item name, tab bar labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section eyebrow above a heading, set in uppercase. Use sparingly.

styles.name: quantity
styles.usage: Stepper values and table quantities. Pair with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so counts don't jitter.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; gap between item tile and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile screen gutter; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of empty states; space above the voice button in the sheet.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, category tiles in tables, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, steppers, item tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and lists.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of the bottom sheet; the phone-size modal.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, the voice button, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards on bg. Pair with a line border; the border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet (casts upward).

tokens.name: shadow-frost
tokens.usage: Only the voice button, so it reads as the one primary action.

size.note: Control heights. Every tap target on a phone is at least tap-min.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on mobile (WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple HIG).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Desktop dense controls; the in-row stepper on desktop tables.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input on desktop.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Default button and input on mobile; search field.

tokens.name: voice-button
tokens.usage: Diameter of the voice button in the tab bar and sheet.
